claude.result:
I've successfully implemented the threshold feature for `frai eval`. Here's a summary of the work completed:

## Implementation Summary

### Core Changes (frai-core)

**`packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js`:**
- Added `validateThresholds()` - validates threshold format and ranges
- Added `evaluateThresholds()` - compares metric scores against minimums
- Updated `generateReport()` to accept optional `thresholds` parameter and add threshold results to the report

**`packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js`:**
- Updated `toMarkdown()` to include "Thresholds" section showing PASS/FAIL for each threshold
- JSON reports automatically include new fields when thresholds are specified

**`packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js`:**
- Added 9 new test cases covering:
  - Thresholds without specification (backward compatibility)
  - Passing thresholds
  - Failing thresholds
  - Missing scores
  - Unknown metric IDs
  - Invalid threshold values
  - Markdown report with thresholds

### CLI Changes (frai-cli)

**`packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts`:**
- Added `parseThresholds()` function to validate and parse threshold arguments
- Updated `runEvalCommand()` to:
  - Parse and validate thresholds
  - Exit with code 1 if any threshold fails
  - Exit with code 2 for usage errors (malformed/invalid thresholds)
  - Exit with code 0 if all pass or no thresholds specified
- Added `--threshold` option (repeatable) with custom commander option handler

### Documentation

**`docs/eval_harness_design.md`:**
- Updated MVP scope to document threshold validation feature

## Test Results

✅ All 9 new threshold tests pass  
✅ Backward compatibility maintained (exit code 0 without thresholds)  
✅ CLI builds successfully  
✅ Threshold validation works with:
- Multiple thresholds per invocation
- JSON and Markdown report formats
- Both passing and failing scenarios
- Proper error handling with helpful messages

## Verification Commands

```bash
# Build frai-core
pnpm --filter frai-core build

# Run eval tests  
pnpm --filter frai-core test -- src/eval/index.test.js
# Result: 9 passed, 1 pre-existing failure (unrelated)

# Build CLI
pnpm --filter frai build

# Example CLI usage:
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs outputs.json --references refs.json --threshold exact_match=0.9 --format markdown
# Exit code 1 if threshold fails, 0 if passes
```

The implementation is complete and ready for use. All requirements have been met:
- ✅ Exit codes: 0 (all pass), 1 (any fails), 2 (usage error)
- ✅ Report includes `passed` field and `thresholds` array (JSON)
- ✅ Markdown reports gain "Thresholds" section
- ✅ Proper error handling with metric ID lists
- ✅ Works with custom metrics
- ✅ Backward compatible (no thresholds = same behavior as before)
